page.overview:
Who is Drako?

Drako was a red Asiatic style dragon and an enemy of the and - in particular - of . He was once one of the most feared fighters of the Battle Nexus, until Splinter defeated him. Later on he came back for revenge on Splinter, and also sought the 's . This character was created for the 2003 animated series.

Drako's exact origins remain largely unknown, but Drako once was a competitor in the . Many years ago, he and many other fighters from space, time, and even other dimensions were selected by the as candidates for a match in the Battle Nexus. Drako made ​​it to the finals, but during the last round, he fought against who was taking part for the first time in the tournament. During the battle Splinter's leg was injured, but he adapted and defeated the big lizard single-handedly. Drako was outraged by this humiliating loss and attacked Splinter the following night with when he was caught off guard, but Splinter was assisted by the brave young ronin and the Daimyo himself, who chased Drako and his assassins off with the , preventing anything worse from happening. Drako fled and disappeared from the scene for many years.

He returned years later, when Splinter along with his sons were pulled back again into the Battle Nexus to participate at the next tournament. But Drako also returned and now served as a counselor for the son of the Daimyo in exchange for the War Staff. But the Ue wanted to seize power in the Nexus itself. Drako tried to advise the ninja over the rash course of action to try to attack but the ninja was concerned with revenge. He poisoned Leonardo during the tournament, sending him to the medical ward with little knowledge of what poison was used. They also sent assassins to severely hurt the Damiyo, blame Splinter and install the his son as Damiyo. However, Drako pursued his own plans and also wanted power over the Nexus, in addition to his personal revenge on Splinter for his last defeat. However, Ue was planning on waiting for his full initiation as Daimyo, so Drako had to act. In their final battle for the Daimyo's War Staff he tried to grab the War Staff but Ue anticipated the move and tried to use the Staff but had no knowledge to control it and it rejected him; Drako had been studying its ways and used it against its inheritor. But his dark heart caused the Staff to accidentally open a dimensional wound that threatened to destroy everything that came into contact with it. Despite attempts to save them, Drako and Ue fall into the rift and were thought to be dead.
